messages:
Ethan: Quick heads-up — HyperCoil wants a 3-month POC on Dedicated with a mixed GPU pool (A100 + H100). They asked for a committed monthly hours discount and ability to burst 2x during demo days. Can Deal Desk + Finance flag any blockers?
Priya: Copy. Do we have the exact commit they want? A100/H100 ratio?
Ethan: Customer expects ~2k GPU-hours/mo total. Prefer 70% A100 30% H100 mix to match their workload. Asking for 25% off list for the POC, plus burst at 2x pay-as-you-go rate capped at 20% of monthly hours.
Marta: 25% off is above our standard POC allowance. Need details: are they signing an SOW? Is there an intent to convert to an annual commit after POC? Also need to know whether burst will be billed at standard hosted burst rates or discounted.
Ethan: They'll sign a short SOW for the POC and want options to convert to a 12-month reserved commit if POC succeeds. No firm conversion commitment yet.
Priya: Quick calc: baseline list rate = $1.8/GPU-hour for A100, $3.2/GPU-hour for H100 (on Dedicated list). If we do 1400 A100 hrs + 600 H100 hrs = 2000 hrs, list monthly = (1400*1.8)+(600*3.2)=2520+1920=4440 USD. With 25% off -> 3330 USD/mo. Burst at 2x rate for additional hours billed at 2*list unless we cap.
Marta: Thanks. If they convert later we can roll POC credits into the reserved commit, but Deal Desk requires: (1) written SOW signed, (2) POC capped to 3 months, (3) maximum burst cap enforced, (4) discount limited to POC period.
Tom: Finance here — 25% for that size and no conversion risk is a bit high. We can approve up to 15% off for a 3-month POC without revenue guardrails. 25% would need a CRO sign-off or a commit to at least 6 months or conversion language in SOW.
Ethan: Understood. Customer pushing hard on demo economics. They say if we can do 25% they'll run a larger evaluation footprint during the POC.
Marta: Could propose a compromise: 20% POC discount, with a refundable credit if they sign a 12-month commit within 30 days after POC. Also require burst billed at 1.5x list and hard cap at 20% of committed hours.
Priya: Implementation note for ops: config we will provision: ```pool: "hypercoil-mixed-1" gpus: [{type: "A100", percent: 70}, {type: "H100", percent: 30}] commit_hours: 2000/month burst_policy: {multiplier: 1.5, max_percent: 20}```
Ethan: That compromise sounds promising. Can Deal Desk confirm approval path? If Marta signs off, do we need CFO/CRO?
Marta: If we limit to 20% and require the refundable credit path, Deal Desk can approve. I'll document the exception and include the terms. Anything above 20% discount -> needs Tom + CRO.
Tom: Confirm. Finance approves the conditional 20% POC discount with the refundable credit tied to conversion to a 12mo reserved commit. Need clear billing language in SOW (credit dollars, timing, and conversion mechanism).
deploy-bot: Provision request queued: pool=hypercoil-mixed-1, tentative commit=2000h/month, burst_multiplier=1.5 (pending legal + billing).
Ethan: Great — I'll draft the SOW with the refundable credit clause and send to HyperCoil legal. Marta, can you add the exception memo?
Marta: On it. I'll attach the internal approval doc and note the exact SLA (latency target and uptime) we promised. Also flag that H100 availability may vary regionally; we should include fallback to A100-only at same effective rate if H100 capacity isn't available.
Priya: Ops: add fallback plan in the prod config. Also include expected cold-start behavior for H100 VM types during bursts.
Ethan: Thanks all — I'll post the SOW link once done. :thumbsup:
Marta: Approved (Deal Desk) :white_check_mark: — final approval pending SOW + signed credit terms.
Tom: Finance sign-off (conditional) :money_with_wings: — will lock rates once SOW is signed.
Ethan: Closing this thread; will update with SOW and customer signature. :eyes:
